headline.title: "Socialism's Rise In America. A Biblical Response For The Church."

welcomeMessage: Welcome to Calvary Chapel Antelope Valley! We are glad you are here. Whether you are joining us in person or online, may God bless you today.

announcements.title: Women's Fall Bible Study
announcements.body: Ladies! We are so excited for our Women’s Fall Bible Study titled “Christ Alone.” We will be studying through the book of Colossians. Our time together will include a time of teaching, worship, group discussion and food. If you desire to grow in your walk with the Lord and in the understanding of the Word then come and join us Tuesday evenings at 6:30 PM. Grab a flyer on the Women’s Ministry Table in the foyer and sign up today!We would love for you to join us!

announcements.title: Men's Bible Study
announcements.body: Men! Come join us Tuesday evenings at 6:30 PM for our Men’s Bible Study through Colossians. This time together will include worship, the Word, food, and fellowship with your brothers in Christ.

announcements.title: 2026 Men's Retreat
announcements.body: Men! Come join us November 13th - 15th at Pinecrest Christian Conference Center for this years Men’s Retreat. The cost is $220 which includes the conference, lodging, and 5 meals during that weekend. Please sign up in the foyer.

announcements.title: Operation Christmas Child
announcements.body: Demonstrate God's love to a child through a gift filled shoe box presented with the gospel of Jesus Christ.  Instructions, boxes, labels, available in the courtyard.  Return filled shoe boxes by National Collection Week, Nov. 16-23, 2026.

announcements.title: Young Adults Friendsgiving
announcements.body: Young Adults! Come join us Monday November 23rd at 6PM for fellowship, food, worship, and time in the Word at our friendsgiving event. This is a potluck event so please bring your favorite thanksgiving dish to share, Sign up in the foyer for the address

announcements.title: Thanksgiving Service
announcements.body: Come and join us Wednesday November 25th at 6:30 PM for a night of prayer and worship and a special time of giving thanks to the Lord.

announcements.title: Woman's Christmas Dinner
announcements.body: Ladies! You’re invited to our annual Woman’s Christmas Dinner here at the church Saturday December 5th at 5 PM. Cost is $35 per person. Register by November 29th using the QR code on the flyer or by signing up and paying in the bookstore.

announcements.title: Baptism
announcements.body: Come join us December 6th after second service for food, fellowship, and to celebrate with those publicly declaring their faith in Jesus through baptism. Please sign up in the foyer if you want to be baptized.

announcements.title: Youth Friendsgiving Event
announcements.body: High School and Junior High! Come out and join us for our Youth Friendsgiving Event on Friday November 20th from 4 PM - 8 PM. This is a potluck event so bring your favorite side dish or dessert or drinks to share!  Flyers and  sign up in the foyer.

theme: "Socialism's Rise In America. A Biblical Response For The Church." — With Guest Speaker: Charlie Campbell
